title: Choosing Devices and Distribution Channels for an Audience

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of how to match devices and distribution channels to a target audience — considering age, ability, access, and context of use.

items.title: You Should Learn to Program — Christian Genco TEDxSMU
items.description: Explores how digital products reach different audiences and why understanding your users shapes every technology decision.

items.title: The ethical dilemma of self-driving cars — Patrick Lin TED
items.description: A real-world case study in how the target audience and distribution context (roads, regulators, vulnerable users) affect digital product design.

items.title: Introducing How Computers Work — Code.org
items.description: Code.org's accessible introduction to how devices work — good grounding for understanding why different devices suit different audiences.

items.title: WALL-E (2008)
items.description: Pixar's vision of technology adapted for a single audience — humanity — raises questions about how distribution channels shape society over time.

items.title: GOV.UK — Accessibility requirements for public sector websites
items.description: Official UK government guidance on making digital products accessible to all audiences — key context for choosing the right device and channel.

items.title: W3C WAI — How People with Disabilities Use the Web
items.description: Explains the diversity of users and how different devices and interaction methods must be considered when choosing distribution channels.

items.title: OCR Cambridge Nationals IT — Specification at a Glance
items.description: Check which audience and distribution channel content the OCR J836 exam tests — know exactly what's required.
